disposition_reason: Table 4 prints minimum, maximum and mean ± SD of As, Cr, Cu, Fe, Mn, Ni, Pb, Se, V and Zn in raw cow milk from dairy farms grouped by drinking-water source; Cd was not detected in any milk sample.

study.design: Farm survey of raw milk, livestock drinking water, soil and forage at 30 small and medium dairy farms
study.origin: Dairy farms in Bell Ville, Morrison, Cintra and San Antonio de Litín counties, southeast Córdoba province, Argentina
study.market: not applicable (raw milk collected on farm)
study.method: Dry ashing, HCl dissolution; ICP-OES (PerkinElmer Optima 2000) with yttrium internal standard; As by hydride generation ICP-OES
lod: Milk detection limits: Cr <3.5, Pb <5, Se <5, V <2 ng/g (Table 4); Cd 3 ng/g (text)
study.qa: NIST-8435 milk powder used for verification; recoveries in Supplementary Tables SI-SII (not in PDF); certified values for As, Cd, Cr, Ni and V not available in that CRM, so the authors call those data preliminary

controls.outcome: As mean 4 (A) vs 3.5 (B) ng/g; Pb 23 vs 24 ng/g; differences in Cu, Fe, Mn, Zn not significant (ANOVA, Kruskal-Wallis). Water As 1282 vs 56 µg/L
